Callout.Name: Bomb Threat - Public Building
Callout.Message: Threat called in against a public building.

Script.Line: We brought everybody out through the fire exits. Nobody went back for anything.
There are two hundred people on the pavement. Somebody has to tell them where to go.
The call was four minutes long and he knew the layout of the building.

Stages.Stage: Evacuation is complete and nobody is unaccounted for.
Search finished. Nothing found, building handed back.

Lines.Briefing: A threat is not a device. Clear the building, hold the cordon, let the team work.
Lines.Approach: The call came to the front desk and the building is coming out now. Nobody goes in.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
